sketches.mechanism: Ownership transfer (move semantics) — after giving a value away, the original binding is consumed and can never be used again
sketches.resonance: When you truly give yourself to someone, there is no copy left behind; the giver ceases to exist in that form.

sketches.mechanism: The Maybe monad and pattern matching — a function that unwraps a Maybe but only handles Nothing, never Just
sketches.resonance: Waiting is only defined for the case where nothing arrives; if something ever came, we wouldn't know what to do with it.
sketches.draft:
wait :: Maybe a -> ()
wait Nothing = wait Nothing
wait (Just _) = undefined

sketches.mechanism: A goroutine sends on a channel that no one receives from — it blocks forever, a permanent deadlock detected at runtime
sketches.resonance: A voice that speaks into a channel with no listener will wait forever, and the runtime itself will declare that nothing is alive.
